items.title: MC1540513: Microsoft SharePoint Online and OneDrive for the web: Updated search experience with Copilot Search
items.summary: SharePoint Online and OneDrive on the web are updating to a unified Copilot Search experience with natural-language prompts, AI summaries, and filters. Rollout starts mid-October 2026 (preview) and mid-January 2027 (general). Users can opt out during preview; minimal action required from organizations.

items.title: MC1540351: Microsoft Teams: Automatically add tag members to channels with Workflows
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a Workflows app template to automatically add users to channels when they are added to a team tag. This optional feature, rolling out worldwide in mid-December 2026, helps streamline access for location- or project-based groups without default changes.

items.title: MC1540345: Action required: Update permissions for Exchange Online Admin API
items.summary: Microsoft is updating Exchange Online Admin API v2.0 permissions, replacing Exchange.ManageV2 and Exchange.ManageAsAppV2 with new permissions by November 2026. Affected applications must transition, obtain admin consent, verify RBAC roles, test, and remove old permissions to maintain access. No endpoint changes occur.

items.title: MC1540342: Action required: Exchange Online Admin API MailboxFolderPermission response update
items.summary: Microsoft will update the Exchange Online Admin API v2.0 MailboxFolderPermission endpoint to return the User property as a structured object with DisplayName, Name, and PrimarySmtpAddress by early November 2026. Organizations must update applications to handle this change to avoid errors.

items.summary: The Planner Plugin integrates Microsoft Planner with Copilot Cowork, enabling task prioritization, completion assistance, plan creation, visual reporting, and cross-Microsoft 365 work using Planner data. items.title: MC1540327: Action required: Prepare users who can’t use passkeys for SMS and voice retirement
items.summary: Prepare users relying solely on Microsoft-provided SMS/voice MFA for sign-ins that don’t support passkeys by February 1, 2027 (non-admins) and July 1, 2027 (admins/external). Register compatible alternatives or configure customer-managed telephony to avoid sign-in blocks during phased retirement.

items.summary: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 2 introduces a "Move to Quarantine" remediation action, allowing admins to move suspicious emails from user mailboxes to Defender quarantine for safer investigation and management. Rollout begins late November 2026, with no action required but policy and role reviews recommended.

items.summary: Microsoft Copilot now fully integrates Office apps, enabling users to create, edit, and collaborate on Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files within the Copilot app. The rollout completes by mid-November 2026. items.summary: Microsoft Copilot Chat's Planner Agent is enhanced with task assignment, scheduled task catch-up, and memory integration to improve task management and personalized responses. items.title: MC1539001: Microsoft 365 admin center: Project usage report retirement
items.summary: The Project usage report in the Microsoft 365 admin center will be retired on December 4, 2026, due to the retirement of Project Online and Project for the web. Administrators should export needed data by November 20, 2026, and use the Planner usage report instead. The Project desktop client remains supported.

items.title: MC1539000: Microsoft Outlook: Search within a selected folder
items.summary: Outlook will allow users to limit search results to a selected mail folder, enhancing search control. This feature will roll out globally in mid-November 2026. No action or compliance concerns are required.

items.title: MC1538999: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot connectors in Work IQ APIs
items.summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot will extend Work IQ APIs to use data and tools from connected enterprise systems via Copilot connectors, enabling richer AI experiences without extra setup. Rollout starts late November 2026. Existing permissions, controls, and governance remain unchanged; no admin action is needed.

items.summary: Microsoft Purview planned new summary metrics in Content Explorer to show unscanned files and classification history, aiding admins in data governance. Public preview was set for late July 2026, but general availability was canceled. No action is required; the feature would have been enabled by default.

items.title: MC1519122: Microsoft Copilot: UBB models in Chat and Word, Excel, and PowerPoint via the model selector
items.summary: Microsoft is rolling out usage-based billing (UBB) models for Copilot Chat and Copilot in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint starting November 2026. Users need a Copilot subscription with UBB enabled and allocated credits to access advanced AI models like GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1. Admins manage access and credits.

A monthly nonintrusive "What’s New" dialog will inform users. No admin action is required; users and help desks should be informed.

items.summary: Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management portal will get a refreshed Analytics & Reports experience with updated design, simplified navigation, and new Room and Desk analytics sections. items.summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Learning Agent will feature AI Skills Navigator playlists, offering curated learning resources via natural language queries. items.summary: Microsoft Defender RBAC will be auto-enabled in your tenant starting December 2026, unifying access management for Defender and Sentinel. items.summary: Intelligent call delegation moves from Frontier to public preview (Ring 3.6) starting Nov 17, 2026, using AI to screen calls and schedule via Microsoft Bookings. Rollout runs Nov-Dec 2026; general availability in Jan 2027. Usage-based billing requires admin spending policy setup in Microsoft 365 admin center.

items.summary: Microsoft Planner's My Tasks experience will be redesigned for clearer navigation, better task organization, and streamlined task creation. items.summary: Microsoft Teams is replacing the Copilot meeting policy with two new policies—MeetingAI and TranscriptionWithMeetingAI—for clearer control over AI features and transcription in meetings. items.summary: Microsoft Teams will enable organizers to send email invitations with registration links for events starting mid-November 2026. items.title: MC1469958: Microsoft Purview: Auto-labeling scalability, policy management, and reporting enhancements
items.summary: Microsoft Purview enhances auto-labeling with increased simulation capacity (4M to 20M items), expanded SharePoint site targeting, improved reporting including Sensitive Information Type summaries, and a 30-day processing chart. Rollout begins mid-November 2026; no user impact or required action.

items.title: MC1470410: Microsoft Teams: QR code protection for messages from external users
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will blur QR code images from external users by default starting mid-October 2026 to reduce phishing risks. Users can reveal codes if trusted. No admin action is needed, but admins should inform users and update guidance. The feature applies across all Teams platforms automatically.

items.summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new admin policy allowing automatic blocking of identified external meeting bots from joining meetings. items.summary: Microsoft Teams is enhancing live captions with a new right-side panel view and a consolidated settings menu for easier configuration. items.title: MC1443518: Microsoft Teams: Expanded presenter visibility in Manage what attendees see
items.summary: Microsoft Teams is enhancing presenter visibility in "Manage what attendees see" by allowing event organizers and producers to drag and resize the presenter panel, displaying more presenters simultaneously. items.title: MC1466307: Microsoft Teams: Centralized notification settings for channels
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce centralized channel notification settings by early October 2026, allowing users to manage all channel notifications from one location. This feature, enabled by default, preserves existing settings and requires no admin action. Users should be informed and internal guidance updated…

items.title: MC1317836: Microsoft Teams: Unblock users to send message while file is uploading in the background
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will allow users to send messages while files upload asynchronously in the background, improving real-time collaboration. The rollout starts August 2026 and affects all platforms. No action is required, and existing compliance and security policies remain unchanged.

items.title: MC1330891: Microsoft Teams: Breakout rooms now supported in meetings with up to 1,000 attendees
items.summary: Microsoft Teams now supports breakout rooms in meetings with up to 1,000 attendees, allowing up to 100 breakout rooms per meeting. This feature, enabled by default, removes previous meeting size limits for breakout rooms. Rollout begins July 2026, completing by November 2026. No action is required.

items.title: MC1323270: Microsoft Teams: Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) support for Teams meetings and events
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will support Secure Reliable Transport (SRT) for town halls and live events starting June 2026, offering improved video streaming reliability and backup streams with automatic failover alongside existing RTMP. No user impact; admins must enable SRT via policy settings.

items.title: MC1266027: Microsoft Teams: New experience when users minimize the meeting window
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new minimized meeting experience by late November 2026, allowing users to raise hands and send reactions without restoring the full window. Two minimized views—expanded (shows up to four videos) and compact (no videos)—are enabled by default, with no impact on screen sharing.

items.title: MC1521613: Microsoft Teams: Streaming switchboard for NDI sources in meetings and events
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce a streaming switchboard allowing event producers to select and stream up to eight NDI sources in meetings and events, available worldwide by mid-November 2026. Admins must enable NDI streaming via policy, and users must activate production capabilities in Teams to use this feature.

items.title: MC1528014: Microsoft Teams: Two presenters can share their screens or windows simultaneously in meetings
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will allow two presenters to share screens or windows simultaneously in meetings starting early December 2026. This feature, enabled by default, lets participants view both shared contents at once. Admins can control this setting at the tenant level and organizers can manage it per meeting.

items.title: MC1530615: Microsoft Teams: Report guest invitations for security concerns
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will let users report suspicious guest invitations for security concerns starting mid-November 2026. Reports go to IT admins via the Teams admin center. No action is needed if "Report a security concern" is already enabled in messaging policies, which control this feature.

items.title: MC1518033: Microsoft Teams: Onboarding workflow for new team members
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce an onboarding workflow to automatically connect new members to relevant channels, improving engagement and onboarding speed. Rollout starts mid-November 2026 for Targeted Release and early December 2026 for General Availability. No admin action is required.

items.title: MC1470887: Microsoft Teams: Personal message reminders for chat and channels
items.summary: Microsoft Teams will introduce personal message reminders for chat and channel messages starting mid-November 2026, enabling users to create, manage, and receive notifications for reminders privately. The feature is enabled by default, requires no admin action, and supports desktop and mobile platforms.
